g.text: Agentic Marketing Playbooks: one LLM call at design time, a deterministic factory at run time
Four marketing use cases -> one Playbook recipe -> ordinary crm_campaign occurrences -> the existing send rail, unchanged
what gets approved — bindings, not values
every 5 minutes, forever, with ZERO LLM calls
one occurrence per firing — campaign_code is the idempotency key
zero new idempotency machinery — the UNIQUE constraint already exists
-- no row returned -> already minted -> skip.
-- A double tick cannot double-send. No new machinery.
param_bindings — declarative, resolved per recipient at send time (5 whitelisted source prefixes)
event_batch latency = the tick interval (5-15 min), not real time -> upgrade to a Dagster sensor on the S3 stream
one message per profile per event_batch window -> add dispatch_key to the ledger if needed
fire_on[] dates are hand-seeded (Tet and Trung Thu are lunar) -> add lunardate, generate them server-side
every occurrence enters here — 0 lines changed, except one file
Everything dashed in this column already
exists, is deployed, and is tested.
The recurrence layer does not touch
the ledger, webhooks, the S3 event lake,
That is the whole blast radius.
An unresolved binding writes a Skipped
ledger row. It NEVER sends a message
A ZNS message reading "Tong diem: " is
worse than no message at all.
OCCURRENCE CONTRACT — what the tick writes into an ordinary crm_campaign row
channel zalo_zns -> routes to notification_engine in triggers.py
template_id <playbook.template_id> -> activation re-checks it is still Approved
approval_status Approved -> inherited; InReview if copy was regenerated
metadata { playbook_id, occurrence_key, param_bindings, use_case, fired_at }
PHASED DELIVERY — each phase independently demoable
P0 crm_campaign_playbook table + RLS + DAO models
P2 playbook_tick + occurrence minting (segment mode only)
P3 per-recipient param bindings <- the ONLY send-path change
P5 the same resolver imported into email_engine
P6 playbook ops UI: next fire time, occurrence history, pause
Land P2 before P3. Occurrence minting is then proven against the
UNMODIFIED send path, so when the send path finally changes there
is exactly one variable in play.
THE WHOLE THING IN ONE LINE
